text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way back from our outing,
Air Messiah and I dropped by an optical shop.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Sorry to keep you waiting.
choice_data_list: Was there something wrong with the glasses?
Was there something wrong with the glasses?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
No, just regular maintenance.
I had my eyesight tested while waiting, and it was the exact same value as last time.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry to drag you along
during your precious time off.
choice_data_list: No, because these must be very important adjustments.
No, because these must be crucial adjustments.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: As a Trainer, I wanted to deepen my understanding of my trainee. I told her not to hesitate to speak up if there were any other places she wanted to go.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I'm deeply grateful for your concern. In that case,
would you mind keeping me company for just a little longer?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I see, the handle is curved so you can thoroughly brush
all the way down to the base of the tail, right?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"The one next to it is made of a new antistatic material...
I wonder how much of a difference it makes...?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Air Messiah carefully examines each tail brush,
one by one, comparing their varied shapes
and materials without missing a single detail.
choice_data_list: So you want a new tail brush?
Do you want a new tail brush?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
If there's a good one, sure.
Though there's nothing particularly wrong with my current brush...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Among the new products developed every day,
there might be something that helps keep me in even better condition.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I hear the condition of the tail affects running. It makes sense to look for a brush that suits one's body better.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... The current brush should be fine for the time being.
Let us head to the next shop.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"These shoes have rather thick soles...
They look like they'd reduce fatigue, but the fit is..."
choice_data_list: Why don't you try them on for size?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
No, I'm fine.
I'm just checking out the new products.
choice_data_list: There's probably a lot we'll learn just by trying it out.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
That is true, but...
It would take up a lot of your time, wouldn't it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I tell her that I don't mind at all.
I added that, in fact, it's a great opportunity
to learn more about my trainee's tastes and preferences.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: I see. You're quite the hard worker, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much.
I'll get permission from the clerk and try them on.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We tried on every pair of shoes that caught our eye,
exchanging our thoughts before finally purchasing a pair.
Before we knew it, the sun was already beginning to set.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Allow me to thank you once again.
It was far more meaningful than going around on my own.
choice_data_list: Same here. Do you do that kind of investigation often?
Same here. Do you do that kind of investigation often?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Yes, at least once a month.
You can look up a fair amount through online articles, but seeing the real thing in person is important too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I knew she was serious, but to take the initiative on tasks
like this without leaving them to her Trainer...
It really hits home just what an incredible hard worker she is.
choice_data_list: I think that's a great attitude. Truly.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I am glad to receive your praise.
However...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
This was the only way for me to win—
I truly believe that says it all.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Lacking standout talent and the drive to take that one extra step forward—surrounded by brilliant rivals, my light shines weakly.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I can't break out of my serious nature.
All I can do is handle things with earnest dedication.
However—that is precisely my greatest strength.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Even plain earnestness can break through someday.
Even if it's just a difference of 0.001 seconds, if you stack them up, you'll become 0.01 seconds, 0.1 seconds faster.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
If there's even the slightest bit of potential in the new products around me, I won't give up.
I will simply keep searching, earnestly and steadfastly.
choice_data_list: That's Air Messiah for you.
That's Air Messiah for you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: She truly is a strong-willed Umamusume. I have nothing but respect for her.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...I know I said that, but after you kindly invited me
to take a breather, it hurts to end the day like this.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
We still have a little time, so...
would you like to go on that "outing" this time?
choice_data_list: Sounds good. Where should we go?
Sounds good. Where should we go?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The two of us took out our smartphones and looked up nearby shops.
Browsing through various options, a certain place caught our eye.
choice_data_list: How about... that 3D latte art cafe?
I think I'd like to check out a stationery store.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: 3D latte art, you say?
choice_data_list: I thought it was kind of over the top...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, maybe so...?
It sounds intriguing, so shall we go?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, Air Messiah and I went to a 3D latte art café, but...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, what a lovely cat design.
It almost feels like a waste to drink it.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
However, I feel like I see this sort of thing from time to time...
Is it truly something extraordinary?
choice_data_list: H-How is it, I wonder...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tilting their heads at the cat made of firm milk foam,
the two of them thoroughly enjoyed both its cuteness
and the delicious latte.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Sounds great...!
To tell you the truth, I really love stationery.
choice_data_list: Me too. It's fun just looking at them.
Me too. Just looking at it is plenty of fun.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Gazing at them is nice, but
I also love going around testing out the sample pens.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I find a pen that handles sweeps and stops well, I instinctively end up writing "Good morning" and the like.
I always make sure to buy spares of pens like that.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
What kind of pens do you like, Trainer?
Please let me know if you don't mind.
choice_data_list: Of course! Let's show each other our favorite things.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An unexpected topic got things lively,
and our conversation didn't stop on the way to the stationery store.
We had a wonderful time even after arriving at the shop.
